title: Scaling Multilingual Pretraining of Pixel Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pixel language models process text as rendered images instead of a finite vocabulary, which gives them strong cross-lingual transfer abilities. However, not much is known about how these abilities are influenced by larger-scale pretraining. In this paper, we train a family of MPIXEL models along three axes of variation: more languages, more scripts, and larger model capacity under fixed per-language compute. In evaluations on five tasks covering 83 languages, we find that scaling acts locally: each axis improves the added languages and scripts, while increased capacity mitigates the curse of multilinguality from pretraining on more languages. Transfer to unseen scripts improves with multilingual pretraining, but does not further improve with scaling. translated_title: 扩展像素语言模型的多语言预训练
translated_abstract: 像素语言模型将文本处理为渲染的图像而非有限的词表，这赋予了它们强大的跨语言迁移能力。然而，关于这些能力如何受到更大规模预训练的影响，目前知之甚少。在本文中，我们沿三个变化维度训练了一系列MPIXEL模型：更多语言、更多文字系统，以及在固定单语言计算量下更大的模型容量。在覆盖83种语言的五项任务评估中，我们发现扩展的作用是局部的：每个维度都能改善新增加的语言和文字系统，而增加模型容量可以缓解在更多语言上进行预训练所带来的“多语言诅咒”。向未见过的文字系统的迁移能力随多语言预训练而提升，但不会随扩展而进一步提升。在类型学上差异较大的低资源语言上，我们的模型在多种书写系统中均优于子词级和字符级基线。我们还展示了更大的像素模型会保留更多的层……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从更多语言、更多文字系统和更大模型容量三个维度扩展像素语言模型的多语言预训练，发现扩展的收益主要作用于新增语言，更大的模型容量可缓解多语言诅咒，且模型在低资源语言上优于子词级和字符级基线。
en_tdlr: This paper scales multilingual pretraining of pixel language models along languages, scripts, and model capacity, showing that scaling benefits mainly newly added languages, larger capacity mitigates the curse of multilinguality, and the models outperform subword and character-level baselines on low-resource languages.
